integrity: The bracket, lower-central series, center, metric inertia, Jacobiator, generic Malcev identity, and Levi-Civita products were reconstructed symbolically from the displayed family. Flatness is attributed to and checked against the primary-source construction; no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result is a sharp boundary example inside one explicit six-dimensional family; it does not classify all flat nilpotent Malcev algebras of metric index \(2\).

No dimension-minimality claim is made. Flatness is taken from the primary source and the included checker independently verifies the new structural deductions, the Malcev identity, and the metric index.
title: Index two is already enough for flat nilpotent non-Lie Malcev algebras
